exposure: Age at diagnosis (V-EoE: ≤12 months vs. L-EoE: 14-18 years)
cohort: Pediatric patients with eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE) (V-EoE: n=57, L-EoE: n=70)
finding: Very early onset EoE (V-EoE) was associated with higher rates of histologic remission through dietary restriction, increased basal zone hyperplasia and eosinophil inflammation, and lower endoscopic scores compared to later-onset EoE (L-EoE).
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common in patients with V-EoE.
